scope: Proposition 5.2 of the manuscript “The equivariant cohomological Hikita conjecture for arbitrary quivers” (preprints/The-equivariant-cohomological-Hikita-conjecture-for-arbitrary-quivers-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 044 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9f66ad939e0e51ec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The quotient B0 for the full topological torus satisfies the coefficientwise graded bound Hilb(B0; q) ≤ X m∈M(v) qC(v)−Dm+w·(v−l) hm(q). (5.4) Every exponent displayed in the sum is a nonnegative integer.
